title: Authorization Standard: How Many Certificates of Deposit One Customer May Hold
content:
Customers of Piedmont Crescent Bank commonly ladder several Certificates of Deposit, and two counts bound how many they may hold at once. Both are examined before a new certificate is opened.

## 1. The standard

1.1 The count of the customer's certificates whose status is not closed must be below 20 before a new certificate is opened.

1.2 The count of the customer's certificates of the requested tier whose status is not closed must be below that tier's published figure for the most open certificates of the tier one customer may hold.

1.3 Certificates in applied status, in active status and in the grace period all count toward both figures. Closed certificates do not.

1.4 Reaching either count declines the opening, and no certificate record is created.

## 2. Evidence and the object each count is taken over

Both counts are taken from the bank's own certificate records and settled before the opening, not from what the customer says they hold. The first count is taken over every certificate that names the customer as owner; the second is taken over the certificates that name the customer as owner and stand in the requested tier.

## 3. Condition and judgement

| Certificates not closed, all tiers | Certificates not closed, requested tier | Tier figure for that tier | Judgement |
|---|---|---|---|
| below 20 | below the tier figure | — | the opening may proceed |
| 20 or more | below the tier figure | — | declined, no record written |
| below 20 | at or above the tier figure | — | declined, no record written |
| 20 or more | at or above the tier figure | — | declined, no record written |

## 4. Worked reading on hypothetical holdings

A customer holds 19 certificates that are not closed, of which 4 are 12-Month Certificates. The tier figure for the 12-Month Certificate is 5. Nineteen is below 20 and four is below five, so a further 12-Month Certificate may be opened. Were the twentieth certificate already standing, the first count would be met at 20 and the opening would be declined however few of them stood in the requested tier.
